records.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single production-ready 2D fighting-game character sprite, a new pose of the SAME adult female H1 fighter. Input image 1 is the primary identity, anatomy, outfit, line-art, cel-shading and EXACT PIXEL-SCALE reference. Input image 2 is supporting reference for that same body's horizontal anatomy and clothing only, NOT a death expression. Preserve the short black bob haircut, face, open red cropped track jacket with white shoulder/sleeve stripes, white cropped tank top, charcoal loose pants with red side stripes, white fingerless hand wraps and red-and-white sneakers. Match the original crisp black anime outline and restrained cel shading. Canvas exactly 1254 by 1254 pixels, RGBA with genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop. Use the SAME anatomical scale as the standing reference: a fully standing body would have hair top around y=74 and soles around y=1194, with a logical sprite root x=627. Do not enlarge the head, hands, shoes or body to fill empty space; do not miniaturize. The whole character must remain inside the canvas with transparent margin. Exactly one character, two arms, two legs, no duplicated anatomy, no attacker or extra person. No text, panels, floor line, scenery, cast shadow, effects, motion trails, logos or watermark. This is a living fighter recovering from a nonlethal throw, with no blood or death symbols.
Primary request: draw ONLY the thrown victim in the middle of a shoulder-throw somersault. The entire body is AIRBORNE and clearly UPSIDE DOWN: head is BELOW the hips, bent knees and sneakers ABOVE the hips. Curve the torso and tuck the knees over the body into a compact backward-over-shoulder tumble; both wrapped arms reach outward for balance. This must unmistakably read as a person being flipped through the air, never a standing or jumping upright fighter. Keep the same side-view/three-quarter game camera and make the readable silhouette usable when horizontally mirrored. Center the compact airborne body in the canvas with ample transparent margin on all four sides and no body part touching an edge. Maintain real limb lengths from input 1 rather than a small chibi figure. The face is alert or strained with open eyes, not unconscious.
records.visual_notes: Generated pose visually matches requested action; exact geometry and runtime alignment left to root.
